notes: 订位这条链路大修。机器人现在一次把要问的问齐（分店、日期、时间、人数、称呼、电话），不再一句一句挤——以前顾客要来回打四轮字，多数人打到第三轮就不订了。问齐之后它会把整份念回给顾客核对，顾客回一句「对」才变成一条等你确认的预约，所以你看到的每一条都是顾客自己复核过的。多家分店终于真的记下来是哪一家，你的列表里每条都带分店；你点「有位，确认」之后，顾客会多收到一条门店地址和电话。新增「每个时段开放多少位」：给每天划几段（例如 18:00–20:30 收 50 位），填好一天点一下复制到其他营业日；默认只在后台显示「这个时段已订 18 / 50 位」，让你确认时不用心算，想让机器人自己挡掉排满的时段可以再打开那个开关。不填就是不限，跟以前完全一样。修复：机器人不再在中文对话里蹦出英文（以前顾客答一句自己的名字就会触发）；预约办完之后不会再回头问一遍分店和日期；「帮我整理一下」不再因为模型「想太久」而失败，系统会自己想办法，不再叫你把资料分成两段；后台说明文字里那些裸星号不见了；后台「打开这条会话」现在真的跳到那条会话。有没有位始终你说了算——剩位只用来挡，绝不替你答应。配置和聊天记录都不会丢。
notesEn: A big overhaul of bookings. The bot now asks for everything it still needs in one message (outlet, date, time, party size, name, phone) instead of dragging the customer through four rounds of typing — most people gave up by the third. Once it has everything it reads the whole thing back for the customer to check, and only turns it into a request for you after they say yes, so every booking you see has been double-checked by the customer. Multi-outlet bookings finally record which outlet, shown on every row in your list, and once you tap Confirm the customer gets a second message with that outlet's address and phone. New: seats open per time slot. Split each day into a few slots (say 18:00-20:30 takes 50 people), fill in one day and copy it to your other open days. By default it only shows you "18 / 50 seats booked in this slot" so you do not have to do the maths when confirming; turn on the switch when you want the bot to start turning away full slots. Leave it empty for no limit, exactly as before. Fixes: the bot no longer breaks into English mid-conversation (previously a customer simply giving their name would trigger it); it no longer circles back to ask about the outlet or date after a booking is already done; "Tidy this up" no longer fails when the model spends its whole budget thinking — the system works around it instead of asking you to split your text in two; stray asterisks are gone from the admin's help text; and "Open this conversation" in the admin now actually opens it. Whether there is a table is always your call — the seat count is only ever used to say no, never to promise on your behalf. Your settings and chat history are untouched.
